# KD Personal Training (KDPT)

> KD Personal Training is run by Kyle Denny, a personal trainer in Northampton, UK, who also coaches clients online. Coaching is built around education, structure and long-term progress rather than generic plans.

## Services

- [1:1 Personal Training in Northampton](https://start.kdpersonaltraining.com/pt): in-person, technique-focused sessions at Trilogy Active, Northampton. Monthly packages: 2 sessions £90, 4 sessions £160, 8 sessions £290. Starts with a free 30-minute consultation.
- [Online Coaching](https://start.kdpersonaltraining.com/online): £120 a month, no lock-in. Custom programme, weekly check-ins with replies within 48 hours, nutrition guidance and messaging in the Everfit app. Works around shifts and nights.
- [Personalised Training Programme](https://start.kdpersonaltraining.com/programmes): £49 one-off. A programme built around your goals, schedule and equipment, delivered in Everfit within 3 to 5 working days.
- [Unstuck, free 30-day programme](https://start.kdpersonaltraining.com/unstuck): 12 full-body gym sessions over 30 days with daily coaching emails and a progress tracker, for people who feel stuck in the gym.
- [Momentum Check](https://momentum.kdpersonaltraining.com): a free self-assessment of training momentum.
